sentences.text:

Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:217686
Court No. - 75
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 45360 of 2023

Applicant :- Mohit
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Umesh Chandra Sharma, J.

1. Heard Sri Amit Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga for the State
and perused the record.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 76 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506 of the I.P.C, Police Station Izzatnagar, District - Bareilly, during the pendency of trial.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the instant case.

Learned counsel for the applicant has further contended that it is a case of purely civil in nature for which no suit for cancellation by any person has been filed against the applicant and the informant.
The applicant was the bona-fide purchaser without value of the property in question.
He had purchased the property-in-question on 04th January, 2022 from Manohar Lal.
A photocopy of the registered sale-deed is on record as Annexure no. 4 to the affidavit.

Mohit vs State Of U.P. on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190801469/
1
When the informant wished the same land for the own purposes, the same was sold to him on 04.06.2022 for a sum of Rs. 8,21,000/-, thus no fraud has been played by the applicant.
The applicant has explained three other criminal history.
The applicant is in jail since 24.05.2023.
In case, he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions made by the counsel for the applicant.
5.
Having regard to the submissions made but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 16.11.2023 Vinod.
